name: online-quiz-battle-backend
description: Online Quiz & Real-time Battle Platform Backend

scripts.build: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { import('path').then(path => { console.log('Backend ready'); const code = 'import app from \'../../backend/src/app.js\'; export default app;'; const dist = path.resolve('../frontend/dist'); if (fs.existsSync(dist)) { fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dist, 'index.js'), code); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dist, 'app.js'), code); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dist, 'server.js'), code); } }) })"
